metadata.input_caveat: Saved command root and endpoint, saved control points and filtered normals; original candidate sets and nominal waypoint targets were not saved
metadata.scope: One paired static IK request per recorded plan; not historical replanning latency or complete route search cost
metadata.fairness: Same saved arm root and source reference problem on B-state distribution; A uses the common initial nominal hand, B keeps the saved source hand seed. Same host, sequential solvers, alternating order; A receives endpoint palm pose only
metadata.optimizer_cost_comparability: Own least-squares objectives differ; compare common four-pad position metric separately

execution_environment.python: 3.10.0 | packaged by conda-forge | (default, Nov 20 2021, 02:18:13) [MSC v.1916 64 bit (AMD64)]
execution_environment.timing_design: One solve per method/event, alternating order; no repeated timing trials or CPU pinning; residual OS load is uncontrolled

A.scope: Logged completed or replan transfer segments only; excludes approach/recontact and any terminal segment without a result event

B.scope: Logged completed or replan transfer segments only; excludes approach/recontact and any terminal segment without a result event

limitations: One seed and fixed object; no statistical population claim
B historical per-call costs/times and rejected candidates were not saved
Offline paired IK is a newly constructed benchmark, not original B search latency
Same supervisor policy, not the same realized wrist path
Supervisor feasibility is predicted with a joint hand candidate that A does not execute; this is a frozen-supervisor ablation, not an independently optimized wrist-only planner
Coverage is a 25 mm graph-geodesic contact neighborhood, not physical skin pressure footprint
